headlines.title: Spooked by hackers and heat waves, the British become proper preppers
headlines.summary: The government’s “Be Ready” campaign advises that Britons be set to fend for themselves for at least three days. Sales show they’re heeding the call.

headlines.title: The temptation of Pope Francis: Private diary reveals torment, visions of Devil
headlines.summary: A new book chronicles the pope’s inner turmoil and his encounters with darkness, including a glimpse of “the entrance to hell.”

headlines.title: Mexico used U.S. drones to arrest alleged drug trafficker ‘El Chapo Isidro’
headlines.summary: Mexico and the United States have long worked together against drug trafficking, but such collaboration can be controversial.

headlines.title: Collapse of U.N. summit intensifies calls for new approach to climate talks
headlines.summary: The failure of COP31 after a dispute about whether a fossil fuel phaseout could even be mentioned has prompted calls for a system that relies less heavily on consensus.

headlines.title: NATO calls urgent meeting as string of incidents escalates Russia tensions
headlines.summary: “We are not in war, but we are certainly not in peace anymore, either,” Germany’s foreign minister said after Russian missiles crashed onto Polish territory.

headlines.title: Land blockade of Iran ‘virtually impossible’, says Araghchi; 2 tankers hit
headlines.summary: Abbas Araghchi cites country’s 'vast territory' and 'large number of provinces' as helping to counter US sanctions.

headlines.title: Iraq orders takeover of oilfields in areas under Kurdish control
headlines.summary: PM Ali al-Zaidi also orders his government to seize all crossings in the Kurdish region after an oil smuggling inquiry.

headlines.title: Russian strike kills two in Ukraine, days after ship attack off Libya
headlines.summary: Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia destroyed a house and damaged a five-storey apartment building, Ukrainian officials said.

headlines.title: Israeli air strikes in Gaza kill 7 as doctors warn of meningitis outbreak
headlines.summary: Gaza health officials say meningitis cases rose to 272 in October, more than eight times the typical monthly rate.

headlines.title: Sheikh Hasina plans to return to Bangladesh from exile on December 16
headlines.summary: Hasina urges Dhaka to arrange her return on the national airline, as government says she can only be extradited.

headlines.title: What should it cost to insure a home in wildfire country?
headlines.summary: Some California homeowners have spent thousands making their homes safer from wildfires. Yet all that work has barely made a dent in their insurance bills. Should they be getting a bigger break?

headlines.title: Doctors struggle to save babies after parents refuse vitamin K
headlines.summary: Doctors are fighting an uphill battle against disinformation about routine vitamin K shots given to newborns in the hospital. It helps prevent a rare but devastating bleeding disorder.

headlines.title: They attended Trump's meme coin dinner. It didn't go well
headlines.summary: Trump's meme coin dinners have sparked intense controversy. These two guests attended his latest on Sunday — and agreed to provide NPR inside access.

headlines.title: Democrats probe whether Trump Jr.-aligned businesses benefit from government access
headlines.summary: Investigators say companies with ties to Donald Trump Jr's investment firm, 1789 Capital, have profited since his father's reelection.

headlines.title: Black travelers on Route 66 weren't welcome at most gas stations — except this one
headlines.summary: Threatt Filling Station in Luther, Okla., was the first Black-owned gas station on Route 66. At a time when Black families needed the Green Book to find places to stay, eat, use the bathroom, it provided fuel and respite.

headlines.title: Students share China trips through language, videos
headlines.summary: Students in the United States shared their experiences in China at an event on Saturday in San Francisco, building stronger cultural ties and fostering mutual understanding between the two countries.

headlines.title: Damaged Russian vessel returns to St Petersburg: governor
headlines.summary: ST. PETERSBURG -- The crew of a Russian vessel, which was hit by a drone in international waters of the Gulf of Finland on Saturday, returned to St Petersburg, Leningrad Region Governor Alexander Drozdenko said Monday.

headlines.title: US stocks surge as Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang
headlines.summary: NEW YORK -- US stocks surged on Monday morning after chipmaker Nvidia announced that it had reinstated Jensen Huang as its chief executive.

headlines.title: Poet's Nobel win shines light on new approach
headlines.summary: Canadian poet Anne Carson's Nobel Prize in literature has renewed attention on her unconventional approach to poetry, which challenges traditional literary forms and pushes the boundaries of language, Chinese scholars and translators say.

headlines.title: Eisenkot decries settler violence
headlines.summary: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, who is tasked with forming Israel's next government, has condemned arson attacks and vandalism against Palestinian homes and vehicles in the occupied West Bank as "Jewish terrorism", the latest escalation since the Gaza conflict erupted in 2023.

headlines.title: President Murmu to inaugurate Bali Jatra in Cuttack during two-day Odisha visit
headlines.summary: President Murmu to inaugurate Bali Jatra in Cuttack and attend a National Scientific Convention on Homoeopathy during a two-day Odisha visit.

headlines.title: Bisleri controversy: Goa FDA steps up surveillance of packaged water brands
headlines.summary: Goa FDA tightens surveillance on packaged water after Bisleri safety dispute; ongoing checks follow a prosecuted batch and market withdrawals.

headlines.summary: SC to hear Sharjeel Imam, Umar Khalid bail pleas in UAPA case over northeast Delhi riots, citing protected witnesses and one-year embargo.

headlines.summary: Congress mocks renaming Jewar airport after Modi, recalls Nehru’s opposition to name changes, questions the project’s flight traffic and timings.

hackerNews.title: 2035 Came Early
hackerNews.summary: tl;dr trynix.dev boots GUI programs now. Try solitaire, GL gears, xeyes, a voice, the weather over curl, or Firefox. I remember watching the talk The Birth & Death of JavaScript by Gary Bernhardt and falling in love with the whimsical yet dreadfully serious unfolding of the story of how JavaScript will come to dominate all software. Others have noted the inevitability of JavaScript’s dominance, so perhaps it was not surprising that Atwood’s Law holds true. Atwood’s LawAny application that can be written in JavaScript, will eventually be written in JavaScript. — Jeff Atwood, 2009 I highly recommend watching the talk…
